title: Local Search for Almost-Spanning Square Grids in Erdős--Rényi Random Graphs
summary: Finding large lattice subgraphs in sparse Erdős--Rényi random graphs is a classical problem at the interface of random graph theory and algorithms. General bounded-degree embedding and universality theorems give powerful results for broad graph families, but when specialized to square grids they operate at densities substantially larger than the grid-emergence scale. In this paper we exploit the specific geometry of the square grid. We introduce the Quarantined Local Search, a three-phase local algorithm that separates the construction of an initial boundary from the later corner-closure…
